proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Reduce to a generator [Z_K] with Z integral closed dominating R, where the specialization map is determined by sp([Z_K]) = [Z_kappa]_r by construction; the inverse image Z' of Z is flat over the DVR by integrality and domination, so its specialization is computed by the specialization-closed lemma; the two flat pullbacks of the generic and closed fibres of Z are computed by the cited Chow Homology lemma and agree with the corresponding fibres of Z', so the square commutes (source lines 527-539)
